sites.name: Hoan Kiem Lake (Sword Lake)
sites.event: Associated with the legend of King Le Loi returning the magic sword to the Golden Turtle God after defeating the Ming invaders, a symbol of the yearning for peace.

place.commune: Hang Trong Ward, Ly Thai To Ward...

sites.name: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum
sites.event: The resting place of President Ho Chi Minh, the beloved leader of the Vietnamese nation.

sites.name: Temple of Literature - Quoc Tu Giam
sites.event: Vietnam's first university, dedicated to Confucius and honoring sages and doctors across dynasties (the Doctors' Stelae are a UNESCO Memory of the World).

sites.name: Imperial Citadel of Thang Long
sites.event: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, the political power center of Vietnam continuously for 13 centuries.

place.commune: Dien Bien Ward, Quan Thanh Ward

sites.name: Duong Lam Ancient Village
sites.event: The first ancient village recognized as a national relic, known as the 'Land of Two Kings' (the birthplace of Phung Hung and Ngo Quyen).

place.hamlet: Mong Phu Hamlet (and Dong Sang, Cam Thinh Hamlets...)

sites.name: Ba Vi National Park
sites.event: Famous for its diverse ecosystem, cool climate, and ruins of French colonial architecture.

sites.name: Perfume Pagoda (Huong Son)
sites.event: One of the largest cultural and religious complexes in Vietnam, home to the Perfume Pagoda Festival, the longest-running festival in the country.

sites.name: Co Loa Citadel
sites.event: The capital of the Au Lac state under King An Duong Vuong, associated with the legend of the Magic Crossbow and the love story of My Chau and Trong Thuy.

sites.name: Hoa Lo Prison
sites.event: Known as the 'Hanoi Hilton' during the war, it was used to detain political prisoners during the French colonial period and American pilots.

sites.name: Bat Trang Pottery Village
sites.event: The most famous traditional pottery village in Vietnam, with a history of over 500 years.

sites.name: West Lake
sites.event: The largest natural freshwater lake in Hanoi, associated with many historical relics and serving as a romantic cultural space.

place.commune: Wards around the lake (Yen Phu, Quang An, Nhat Tan...)

sites.name: Ham Lon Mountain
sites.event: Known as the 'Roof of the Capital' (part of the Doc Ton range), it is a favorite camping and trekking spot for young people.
